overview.description: The Skylar Electricity Futures ETF (MWHS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in electricity commodities. The fund is an actively managed portfolio providing exposure to short-term cash-settled electricity futures, either directly or indirectly through total return swaps. Positions are discretionary, taking into consideration contract trading volumes and/or open interest. MWHS was launched on Jun 29, 2026 and is issued by Skylar.
